card: Keep a lab order with its sample and result.
title: LabFlow for the path through a lab
intro: LabFlow follows diagnostic lab work from a patient and order through sample, result and release. Each hand-off has a place.

sections.heading: What work does LabFlow cover?
sections.body: Diagnostic lab work runs through it from start to finish.

sections.heading: What stays together in the system?
sections.body: Patient, order, sample and result records sit in the same system.

sections.heading: How does a result reach release?
sections.body: A result moves through validation from draft to release.

sections.heading: Where does LabFlow fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps a person’s own health record. LabFlow follows the diagnostic lab’s order, sample, validation and result.
